def solve(inp, rot_cw=True):
    cl=clusters(inp)
    g=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for b,qs in cl.items():
        TL,TR,BL,BR=qs[(True,True)],qs[(True,False)],qs[(False,True)],qs[(False,False)]
        m={(True,True):BL,(True,False):TL,(False,False):TR,(False,True):BR} if rot_cw else \
          {(True,True):TR,(True,False):BR,(False,False):BL,(False,True):TL}
        for k,(r,c,v) in m.items(): g[r][c]=v
    for b,qs in cl.items():
        cy,cx=b[0]+0.5,b[1]+0.5
        for k,(r,c,_) in qs.items():
            v=g[r][c]
            dr=1 if r>cy else -1; dc=1 if c>cx else -1
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]==0:
                g[rr][cc]=v; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return g
